name: financecheck-ai-naail
description: Educational finance and accounting workflows with clear evidence labels, short lessons, privacy gates, and offline numerical checks. No live financial-data MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: FinanceCheck AI offers concise educational explanations of public financial statements, fictional accounting exercises and transparent three-card stories. It can guide arithmetic checks on supplied figures but cannot authenticate company filings, provide a live data service or act as an audit firm or investment adviser. The standalone MCP example is not connected. No private, personal or restricted licensed material.
defaultPrompt: Explain profit versus cash flow using a fictional example.
Calculate growth from these synthetic revenues and show your work.
Make three source-labeled learning cards about revenue and cash flow.

publication.release_notes: V3.1 addresses comparator period and input-safety defects, adds read-only MCP schema annotations, and clarifies non-verification labels.
